name: AI Agent Detection - Scriptable Filter
comment: Advisory AI agent detection with a ScriptableFilter: the embedded Groovy script matches the request User-Agent header against AI agent tokens published in the vendors' crawler documentation (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity) and, on a match, logs the detection and records the matched token in the request attributes (attributes.aiAgentDetected) before passing the request through unchanged. User-Agent headers are spoofable, so a match is advisory identification, not proof that the caller is an AI agent. OpenAI and Perplexity publish IP ranges for their agents and recommend verifying them before enforcing anything; Anthropic recommends handling its agents through user-agent-based robots.txt rules and warns that IP-based methods may not work correctly or persistently guarantee an opt-out. The token list comes from vendor documentation and must be maintained as the vendors publish new agents.

filters.name: AiAgentDetectionFilter
